subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the grouped action refresh land after exact-head security and workflow gates, or should the secret-bearing action updates be split for narrower manual validation?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but it changes third-party executable code at token, secret, scanning, and publishing boundaries that automated source review cannot fully validate.

options.title: Gate and land together
options.body: Rebase the grouped update, require exact-head action-security and workflow checks, and manually smoke representative token, Codex, and release paths before merge.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate Codex, GitHub App token, CodeQL, and Docker publishing updates so each security-sensitive family can be validated and rolled back independently.

options.title: Pause the refresh
options.body: Leave the current pins in place until maintainers have capacity to validate the manual and release-only workflows.

recommendation.title: Gate and land together
recommendation.body: Rebase the grouped update, require exact-head action-security and workflow checks, and manually smoke representative token, Codex, and release paths before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and documented repository responsibility make this the strongest available owner for release and workflow security decisions.
